backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64, so gradient accumulation halves). In a 300s budget more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Nothing else changes.

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so accumulation is minimal. Many more steps. Change nothing else on the first try.

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 so more time is spent at peak LR.

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 to test whether more annealing helps.

backlog.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR does not fully reach zero at the end.

backlog.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.02 to stabilize early Muon and Adam steps.
backlog.title: Short warmup 0.02

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 and ASPECT_RATIO = 85 (dim about 512, a multiple of HEAD_DIM 128) so the model is smaller and sees more tokens in 300s.
backlog.title: Depth 6

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO = 64 (dim 640, a multiple of HEAD_DIM). A bigger model is slower per step; check whether it wins in fixed time.
backlog.title: Depth 10

backlog.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05 for Muon.
backlog.title: Matrix LR 0.05

backlog.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.4 to test a lower token-embedding Adam LR.
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.4

backlog.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.9 to test a higher token-embedding LR.
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.9

backlog.title: Scalar LR 0.25

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for Muon cautious weight decay.
backlog.title: Weight decay 0.1

backlog.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.9, 0.95).
backlog.title: Adam beta1 0.9

backlog.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.
backlog.title: Adam beta2 0.99

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "L" to use full attention in every layer. Check the speed cost against the quality gain.
backlog.title: Window pattern SSSSL-free: all long

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSL" so more layers get full context.
backlog.title: Window pattern SSL

backlog.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 so there are twice as many heads at the same width. Check that the flash attention path supports it.
backlog.title: Head dim 64

backlog.spec: If the Muon momentum is scheduled, raise the final momentum to 0.97 (or the constant momentum from 0.95 to 0.97). If there is no schedule, add a ramp from 0.85 to 0.95 over the first 300 steps.
backlog.title: Muon momentum 0.97 end

backlog.spec: If the model applies a logit softcap (default 15 or 30), set it to 15. If there is none, add softcap*tanh(logits/softcap) with 15 before the loss.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 15

backlog.spec: Replace the MLP activation with SwiGLU at hidden size about 8/3 * dim, rounded to a multiple of 64, so the parameter count stays the same. Measure the effect on throughput.
backlog.title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU-lite

backlog.spec: Zero-initialize the attention c_proj and MLP c_proj weights if they are not already, so the residual stream starts as the identity.
backlog.title: Zero-init output projections

backlog.spec: If value embeddings are only on alternating layers, add them to all layers. Memory and params grow a little. If they are already on all layers, drop them from the first two layers instead.
backlog.title: Untied value embedding every layer

backlog.spec: Wrap the model in torch.compile with mode="max-autotune-no-cudagraphs" if the compile time stays within budget. Compile time is not counted in the 300s, but startup plus training must stay under 450s.
backlog.title: Compile max-autotune

backlog.spec: Change the linear warmdown shape to a cosine decay over the warmdown phase, from 1.0 to FINAL_LR_FRAC, using the same time-progress variable.
backlog.title: Time-based LR schedule with cosine warmdown

backlog.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before the optimizer step, after accumulation. This may help with small-batch stability.
backlog.title: Gradient clipping 1.0

backlog.spec: Increase the rotary embedding base from 10000 to 50000. This is a one-constant change in the rotary precompute.
backlog.title: RoPE base 50000

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (grad accumulation halves, DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE stays 64). In a fixed 300 s budget this doubles the optimizer step count for a small model that is token-starved. Leave all LRs unchanged. No other edits.
backlog.title: Total batch 2**18 with device batch 64

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim 384 with ASPECT_RATIO 64, i.e. 3 heads of 128). Smaller model trains on more tokens in 300 s; depth 10 was much worse, so the trend suggests smaller may help. If dim must stay a multiple of HEAD_DIM, 384 already is. No other changes.
backlog.title: Depth 6 wider-per-time model

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 and ASPECT_RATIO = 85 so model_dim = 510, which the code rounds up to a multiple of HEAD_DIM (512, 4 heads). This gives a shallower but wider model with similar parameter count to the baseline and faster steps. No other changes.
backlog.title: Depth 6 with ASPECT_RATIO 85

backlog.spec: After the backward pass of the accumulated step and before optimizer.step(), call torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0). Stabilizes early high-LR training at small cost. No other changes.
backlog.title: Gradient clipping at 1.0

backlog.spec: Change WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1. In short training runs less weight decay often helps since the model is underfit. Nothing else changes.
backlog.title: Weight decay 0.1 for Muon

backlog.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.06 (from 0.04). Short runs with Muon often tolerate larger LRs. Keep the schedule and other LRs unchanged.
backlog.title: Matrix LR 0.06

backlog.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the warmdown ends at 5% of peak LR rather than zero, a small tweak to the schedule endpoint. No other changes.
backlog.title: Final LR fraction 0.05

backlog.spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN from "SSSL" to "SSSS" (the code should force the final layer to be full-context as usual). Half-context attention is cheaper, giving more steps in 300 s. If the code does not force last layer to be long, set the last layer window to full manually.
backlog.title: Window pattern all-short-except-last

backlog.spec: Change the logit softcap constant in the forward pass (currently probably 30) to 15, i.e. logits = 15 * tanh(logits / 15). Slightly tighter output bounding may stabilize training. No other changes.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 15

backlog.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.9, 0.99) to give the embedding, lm_head and scalar Adam groups smoother, longer-memory moment estimates. Nothing else changes.
backlog.title: Muon momentum warm schedule shortened and Adam beta2 0.99

backlog.spec: In the model forward, apply logits = 15 * tanh(logits / 15) before the cross-entropy loss (replace any existing softcap value). Keep the evaluation path unchanged in behavior, only modify the shared model forward if it already contains a softcap line; otherwise add it right after lm_head in the training loss path only.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 15

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN to "L" so every layer uses full-context attention. With a 6-layer model the sliding windows may cost more quality than they save in speed. Check that the pattern code handles a single-character pattern by tiling it across layers.
backlog.title: Window pattern all long

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.3 so more of the budget is spent at peak LR. Since 0.7 was worse, the trend suggests shorter may be better. No other changes.
backlog.title: Shorter warmdown 0.3

backlog.spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.3. Smaller batches (2^18) make Adam embedding updates noisier, so a lower LR may help. No other changes.
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.3

backlog.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.99) for the Adam groups (embeddings, lm_head, scalars). With more optimizer steps and small batches, smoother second-moment estimates may help. No other changes.
backlog.title: Adam beta2 0.99 with beta1 0.9

backlog.spec: Set HEAD_DIM to 64 at DEPTH 6 and ASPECT_RATIO 64, so model_dim 384 has 6 heads of 64 instead of 3 of 128. More heads can improve attention expressivity at the same parameter count. Make sure rotary and value-embedding shapes follow n_head and head_dim.
backlog.title: Head dim 64 (6 heads)

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH to 4 and ASPECT_RATIO to 128 (model_dim 512, 4 heads of 128). This is a shallower and wider model that gives much higher throughput and more steps in 300 s. Ensure WINDOW_PATTERN still works with 4 layers (the last layer must be long).
backlog.title: Depth 4 wider model

backlog.spec: Since 2^17 total batch was slightly better (-0.0035) but rejected within noise, combine it with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 32 (grad accumulation of 4 steps of 32x2048 = 2^17 tokens). Smaller microbatches lower memory use and may raise throughput. Also set MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to compensate for the smaller batch.
backlog.title: Increase DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 with 2^17 total

backlog.spec: If q and k are already RMS-normalized, multiply the attention scores by a learnable per-layer scalar (initialized at 1.0, optimized with the SCALAR_LR Adam group) by scaling q by this value before attention. Otherwise add QK RMS normalization (F.rms_norm on q and k after rotary) and then the learnable scale initialized at 1.2. This tests sharper attention for short training.
backlog.title: Scale-free QK norm plus learnable attention temperature
